target.statement: AUC of the clust (cluster-cleaning + logistic regression) method with SMOTE under non-SCAR labelling at c=0.3, averaged over Monte Carlo replications on a single small UCI dataset (e.g. wdbc or banknote)
target.table_ref: Fig. 1 (AUC; SMOTE scheme; nonSCAR) / Table 2 (ΔAUC nonscar, calc_c=0.3, clust row)
target.dataset: UCI benchmark datasets (e.g. wdbc, banknote, breastc) with synthetic non-SCAR surrogate labels

compute.basis: Small UCI tables with 2-means + logistic/Lasso + SMOTE in R, up to 100 Monte Carlo reps per dataset; the main cost is reconstructing the non-SCAR labelling and pecking pipeline from the supplement since only R code (no configs) is linked.

blockers: Non-SCAR surrogate-label generation (non_scar_labelling.mvc) must be re-implemented from the supplement description
Exact Monte Carlo seeds / aggregation over datasets not specified, so the headline cell may not match exactly
Code is R (glmnet, caret, smotefamily) rather than a packaged reproducible pipeline
title: PU classification under Non-SCAR: clustering-assisted logistic model with oversampling enhancement
